footer: This email was sent by Leafdesk at {appUrl}.
actionFallback: If the button doesn't work, paste this link into your browser:

test.subject: Test email from Leafdesk
test.heading: Email delivery works
test.body: This is a test message from your Leafdesk server at {appUrl}. If you can read it, email is set up correctly.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to “{workspace}” on Leafdesk
invitation.heading: Join “{workspace}”
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join “{workspace}” on Leafdesk as {role}.
invitation.expires: The link works for 7 days. Sign up with {email} to accept.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Leafdesk password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: Hi {name}, someone asked to reset the password of your Leafdesk account. If it was you, choose a new password with the button below.
passwordReset.expires: The link works for {minutes} minutes and only once. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email; your password stays the same.

assignment.subject: {actor} assigned you to “{row}”
assignment.heading: You were assigned to “{row}”
assignment.optOut: You can turn these emails off in My account > Preferences.

share.subject: {actor} shared “{page}” with you
share.heading: {actor} shared a page with you
share.optOut: You can turn these emails off in My account > Preferences.

comment.subject: {actor} commented on “{page}”
comment.heading: {actor} commented on “{page}”
comment.body: The comment is on “{page}” in {workspace}. Reply or resolve it from the page.
comment.optOut: You get these because you took part in this comment thread. You can turn them off in My account > Preferences.

mention.subject: {actor} mentioned you on “{page}”
mention.heading: {actor} mentioned you on “{page}”
mention.optOut: You get these because someone mentioned you. You can turn them off in My account > Preferences.

reminder.subject: Reminder: {date} on “{page}”
reminder.heading: Reminder: {date}
reminder.body: You asked to be reminded of {date} on “{page}” in {workspace}.
reminder.optOut: You get these because you set a reminder. You can turn them off in My account > Preferences.

automation.subject: Automation “{automation}”: “{page}”
automation.heading: The automation “{automation}” is letting you know about “{page}”
automation.optOut: You get these because a database automation notifies you. You can turn them off in My account > Preferences.

accessRequest.subject: {requester} asked for access to “{page}”
accessRequest.heading: {requester} asked for access to “{page}”
accessRequest.answer: Share the page with them, picking what they can do, or decline the request. You can answer from your inbox or from Share on the page.
accessRequest.optOut: You get these because you have full access to the page. You can turn them off in My account > Preferences.

accessDeclined.subject: Your request for access was declined
accessDeclined.heading: Your request was declined
accessDeclined.body: Your request for access to this page was declined: {link}
accessDeclined.hint: If you still need it, ask the person who sent you the link.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.body: Hi {name}, you asked to use this address for your Leafdesk account instead of {old}. Confirm it with the button below.
emailChange.expires: The link works for {hours} hours and only once. If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this email; nothing changes.

emailChanged.subject: The email address of your Leafdesk account changed
emailChanged.heading: Your email address changed
emailChanged.body: Hi {name}, the email address of your Leafdesk account changed from {old} to {new}. From now on, sign in with the new address.
emailChanged.warning: If you didn’t make this change, contact an owner of your workspace right away.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Leafdesk password changed
passwordChanged.heading: Your password changed
passwordChanged.body: Hi {name}, the password of your Leafdesk account was just changed.
passwordChanged.warning: If you didn’t make this change, reset your password from the sign-in page and contact an owner of your workspace.

join.subject: {asker} asked to join “{workspace}”
join.heading: {asker} asked to join
join.body: {asker} ({email}) asked to join “{workspace}” on Leafdesk. Approve or decline the request in Settings > Members.

invite.subject: {asker} asked to invite {email} to “{workspace}”
invite.heading: A member asked to invite someone
invite.body: {asker} would like to invite {email} to “{workspace}” on Leafdesk. The invitation goes out once an owner approves it.

joinRequest.optOut: You can turn these emails off in My account > Preferences.

joinApproved.subject: You joined “{workspace}”
joinApproved.heading: Welcome to “{workspace}”
joinApproved.body: An owner approved your request to join “{workspace}” on Leafdesk.

joinDeclined.subject: Your request to join “{workspace}”
joinDeclined.heading: Your request wasn't approved
joinDeclined.body: An owner of “{workspace}” declined your request to join. You can ask one of its owners for an invitation.

inviteApproved.subject: {email} was invited to “{workspace}”
inviteApproved.heading: Your invitation went out
inviteApproved.body: An owner approved your request, and {email} was invited to “{workspace}” on Leafdesk.

inviteDeclined.subject: Your request to invite {email}
inviteDeclined.heading: Your request wasn't approved
inviteDeclined.body: An owner of “{workspace}” declined your request to invite {email}.

verification.subject: Verify your Leafdesk email address
verification.heading: Verify your email address
verification.body: Hi {name}, confirm that this address is yours with the button below.
verification.ignore: If you didn't create a Leafdesk account, you can ignore this email.

passwordResetRequired.subject: Choose a new Leafdesk password
passwordResetRequired.heading: Choose a new password
passwordResetRequired.body: Hi {name}, an administrator of this Leafdesk server asked you to choose a new password. Your old password no longer signs you in.
passwordResetRequired.expires: The link works for {minutes} minutes and only once. Signing in with your old password again sends a new one.

push.comment: {actor} commented in a thread you're in
push.accessRequest: {actor} asked for access to this page
push.automation: Automation “{name}”: {actor} added or changed this row
